title: DepRisk reach-request v1
description: Protocol: what the DepRisk CLI sends to the reachability analyzer (deprisk-reach) on stdin. Everything below 'root' is analyzed as one program. Unknown properties are ignored by the analyzer; an unknown schemaVersion is rejected.

language.description: The language of the sources. javascript covers JavaScript and TypeScript (ADR 0019).

mode.description: auto: C#: Main, top-level statements, controllers, hosted services. JavaScript/TypeScript: modules that nothing imports with their exports, and decorated classes. public-api: public members of public types, or everything exported (libraries). none: only 'explicit'.

explicit.description: C#: Namespace.Type.Method (all overloads) or Namespace.Type.* (every member of the type). JavaScript/TypeScript: a function id as reported in the result (path/to/file.js::name, path/to/file.ts::Class.method) or path/to/file.js::* (every function of the file). Added to the mode's entrypoints.

key.description: Opaque; the result is reported under it.

symbols.description: C#: Namespace.Type.Member, Namespace.Type.#ctor, or Namespace.Type.* (any member, including constructors). JavaScript/TypeScript: package::path (for example lodash::template, @scope/pkg::Parser.parse, pkg::default), package::* (any use of the package), or package::Type.* (any member, and constructing it).

complete.description: True only if the list is claimed to contain every public way to reach the flaw. Without it, a missing path is 'unknown', never 'unreachable'.
